Every line, every signal, one control room. Hardware in, decisions out — and nothing leaves the governed path.
Live telemetry, six field protocols — every sample stamped with its batch, recipe and line.

Choose a chart, tune the fields, save the whole recipe as a template. New data, one click, re-plotted.

Ontology makes the plant machine-readable — entities, relations and rules, each bound to a real node.

cues.en: AgentWorkShop — an industrial multi-agent platform, recorded live on a running production line.
cues.zh: AgentWorkShop——工业多智能体平台，在真实运行的产线上实录。

cues.en: Every line, every signal, one control room. Hardware in, decisions out — and nothing leaves the governed path.
cues.zh: 所有产线、所有信号汇入同一个控制室。硬件数据流入，决策流出——每一步都不离开受治理的路径。

cues.en: Live telemetry, six field protocols — every sample stamped with its batch, recipe and line.
cues.zh: 现场遥测，六种现场协议——每个样本都带批次、配方与产线归属。

cues.en: The new E D A pipeline. Pull live data — or bring your own table.
cues.zh: 全新的 EDA 分析管道。实时拉取产线数据——或直接导入你自己的数据表。

cues.en: Shape it with your own code: filters, aggregates, derived columns — executed right in your browser.
cues.zh: 用你自己的代码塑形数据：过滤、聚合、派生列——全部在你的浏览器本地执行。

cues.en: Choose a chart, tune the fields, save the whole recipe as a template. New data, one click, re-plotted.
cues.zh: 选择图型、调整字段，把整套配置保存为模板。换一份数据，一键复绘。

cues.en: Every tool is catalogued with its source, the roles allowed to call it, and the channels that scoped it down.
cues.zh: 每个工具都登记在册：来源、可调用角色，以及把它收窄到具体频道的策略。

cues.en: Agents propose. The platform verifies against bound nodes and live grants. You decide.
cues.zh: Agent 提议；平台按绑定节点与实时授权核验；由你决定。

cues.en: Every call is rate-limited, checked and journaled — by design, not by policy.
cues.zh: 每次调用都限频、校验并留痕——这是代码设计，不是纸面制度。

cues.en: Ontology makes the plant machine-readable — entities, relations and rules, each bound to a real node.
cues.zh: 本体让工厂可被机器理解——实体、关系与规则，每一条都绑定真实节点。

cues.en: Models learn from the line, then serve optimization through a guarded solver. Nothing is trusted until it passes.
cues.zh: 模型从产线学习，经守卫求解器服务优化。没过门禁的模型，一步也不放行。

cues.en: And a solver cross-checks every recommendation against the physics it learned from.
cues.zh: 求解器再用学到的物理关系，对每个推荐做交叉核验。

cues.en: Published as a versioned release, every entity, relation and rule carries its evidence and a content hash.
cues.zh: 发布为版本化版本：每个实体、关系与规则都携带证据与内容哈希。

cues.en: Different agents, different tools, different permissions — scoped down to the node.
cues.zh: 不同 Agent、不同工具、不同权限——作用域收窄到节点级。

cues.en: Four teams share one line, each with its own scenario, tools and evidence trail.
cues.zh: 四个团队共用一条产线，各自拥有独立场景、工具与证据链。

cues.en: Protocols, analyses, twins — all plugins. The diagnostics bridge and knowledge base plug in the same way.
cues.zh: 协议、分析、孪生都是插件；诊断桥与知识库也以同样方式接入。

cues.en: In one live batch, every setpoint was acknowledged and read back; a step-limited request was correctly rejected.
cues.zh: 在一个实机批次中，每个设定值都获得设备回执并回读；一次超步限请求被正确拒绝。

cues.en: Data, decision, action — with proof.
cues.zh: 数据、决策、行动——全程留证。

cues.en: Every chart is a saved, reusable view — owned, versioned, and shareable with the team.
cues.zh: 每张图表都是可复用的保存视图——有归属、有版本,可共享给团队。

cues.en: AgentWorkShop. Open source, plugin-ready, built for the shop floor.
cues.zh: AgentWorkShop。开源、可插件化、为车间而生。
